notes.title: Participation in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025
notes.content: [p]Greetings, friends![/p][p]Today, the team is actively working on the release of the demo, which is scheduled for September-October and will show the first two locations out of seven.[/p][p]In the meantime, our mouse is participating in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 thanks to Indie Cup and Palaye. Thank you all for your support and we will be grateful for adding the game to the wishlist![/p]

notes.title: Indie Cup 2024 and plans for 2025
notes.content:
The[b] Indie Cup 2024[/b] has just ended, where the game made it to the finals and was nominated in two categories. This is an inspiring result, considering that development started not so long ago. The jury praised us for the graphics, logical puzzles and convenient controls. 
In December, an experienced developer joined the team and we hope that the work will go according to plan. We are very grateful to the organizers of the Indie Cup and everyone who added the game to the wishlist and is waiting for its release. A thousand mouse hugs for you. Thank you!

notes.title: Do you love achievements?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175806/6a115c741c2b740a9add00da3c96d6999ec672f0.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!
We continue to work on the game and are happy to see every new subscriber to our community. Today, achievements that many Steam users love so much were added to the game. In parallel, we are creating new puzzles and art for swamp levels.
